images.prompt: A simple diagram illustrating the concept of reinsurance. It shows a primary insurance company (Insurer A) selling policies to individuals, and then Insurer A purchasing a policy from a larger reinsurance company (Insurer B) to cover a portion of its own risk. Arrows show the flow of premiums and potential claims.

images.prompt: A simple diagram showing the payoff profiles for a long call option and a long put option. The x-axis represents the underlying asset price at expiration, and the y-axis represents the payoff. The call option payoff line starts at zero, then rises linearly after the strike price. The put option payoff line starts high, then falls linearly until the strike price, and remains at zero thereafter.
